title: Broaden no_hardcoded_percent_in_chart_subtitle_test.dart regex to catch unsigned fabricated percentages
rule: TQ-8 (assertion weaker than the class of defect the source can actually reproduce)
why: The original defect (per the file's own docstring) was 'a static placeholder ... never computed at runtime' — the fix removed the number entirely. But the regression test only rejects the signed digit-percent shape ('+12%'/'-5%'). A future contributor could reintroduce the same never-computed-at-runtime fabrication as 'chartCumulativeProgressSubtitle: 12% higher than last week' (no sign) or as a non-percent fake stat ('12 more completions than last week'), and this test would pass, giving false confidence that the fix is intact.
recommendation: Widen the guard — at minimum drop the sign requirement (match \d+%), or better, assert the subtitle contains no digits at all, matching the intent that it is now static prose rather than a statistic.
acceptance_criteria: Injecting an unsigned literal like '12%' into chartCumulativeProgressSubtitle in either ARB fails this test

corrections: None — quote and line verified exact; ARB files checked directly and contain no digits.
